title: How to clear Connected Blocks
summary: Treat the linked pair as one unit, find a shared exit, and avoid stranding one color in a dead lane.

seo.title: Clear Block Out Connected Blocks Safely
seo.description: Route Block Out Connected Blocks by treating the pair as one unit, finding a shared exit and avoiding dead lanes.

question: What is the safest way to route Block Out Connected Blocks?

sections.heading: Plan the pair as a single piece
body: Connected blocks move together, so map both footprints at once.
Choose lanes that fit the combined shape without trapping a color.

sections.heading: Aim for a shared clear
body: Look for one move order that removes both linked colors.
If a shared exit is impossible, pick the order that frees the more blocking piece first.

sections.heading: Avoid dead lanes
body: Never separate the colors into lanes where only one can reach an exit.
Keep the partner's path open until the link clears.
